game.title: Evil Cats
hero.name: Arc Light Cat
citadel.name: Nine-Lives Citadel
stormheart.name: Stormheart
order.name: Golden Collar Order
module.arc_coil.name: Arc Coil
module.arc_coil.desc: A lightning conductor that chains between nearby enemies. Best against clustered threats.
module.ember_maw.name: Ember Maw
module.ember_maw.desc: A furnace cannon firing slow explosive shells that set enemies burning (burning is capped).
module.frost_whisker.name: Frost Whisker
module.frost_whisker.desc: An ice bell whose chime slows groups (movement and attacks); repeated chills freeze ordinary enemies briefly.
module.bone_ballista.name: Bone Ballista
module.bone_ballista.desc: Fires piercing bolts through lines of enemies and punches through armour. Weak against swarms.
module.ward_lantern.name: Ward Lantern
module.ward_lantern.desc: Maintains barriers, slowly repairs the citadel and weakens nearby attackers. Costs an offensive slot.
module.gravity_paw.name: Gravity Paw
module.gravity_paw.desc: A rune orb that briefly pulls ordinary enemies together and interrupts their approach. Golems and bosses cannot be pulled, so they take double crush damage instead.
slot.crown.name: Crown
slot.middle.name: Middle
slot.base.name: Base
synergy.syn_storm_frost.name: Conductive Frost
synergy.syn_storm_frost.desc: Arc Coil beside Frost Whisker: Arc Coil chains to 1 extra target.
synergy.syn_ember_gravity.name: Collapsing Fire
synergy.syn_ember_gravity.desc: Ember Maw beside Gravity Paw: explosion radius +20%.
synergy.syn_ward_bone.name: Guarded Volley
synergy.syn_ward_bone.desc: Ward Lantern beside Bone Ballista: ballista attacks 15% faster while a barrier is up.
enemy.rat_raider.name: Rat Raider
enemy.rat_raider.desc: Basic melee soldier of the Order. Comes in packs.
enemy.hound_runner.name: Hound Runner
enemy.hound_runner.desc: Fast, fragile flanker that takes the side paths.
enemy.shield_guard.name: Shield Guard
enemy.shield_guard.desc: Slow and armoured. Bone Ballista pierces its armour.
enemy.crow_archer.name: Crow Archer
enemy.crow_archer.desc: Stops at a distance and shoots the citadel. Use Ranged Threat targeting.
enemy.bat_swarm.name: Bat Swarm
enemy.bat_swarm.desc: Five fragile flyers that ignore the paths. Chains and splash shred them.
enemy.bat.name: Bat
enemy.bell_priest.name: Bell Priest
enemy.bell_priest.desc: Heals nearby enemies with its bell. Make it a priority target.
enemy.powder_rat.name: Powder Rat
enemy.powder_rat.desc: Lights its keg near the citadel, then charges. Stun, freeze or pull it to interrupt the fuse.
enemy.iron_golem.name: Iron Golem
enemy.iron_golem.desc: Slow siege engine with huge health. Cannot be pulled.
boss.sir_barkhelm.name: Sir Barkhelm
boss.sir_barkhelm.title: the Iron Hound
boss.sir_barkhelm.intro: "By order of the Golden Collar, surrender the Stormheart!"
boss.sir_barkhelm.hint: He raises his shield and calls guards; clear the guards. When he steps back and growls, a charge is coming: save Nine-Lives Ward for it.
boss.mother_carrion.name: Mother Carrion
boss.mother_carrion.title: the Bell Crow
boss.mother_carrion.intro: "Ring, ring, little cats. The bell tolls for you."
boss.mother_carrion.hint: She summons swarms and priests. A red sector means a barrage: kill the archers inside it to shrink the barrage, and ward the rest.
boss.king_goldenfang.name: King Goldenfang
boss.king_goldenfang.title: Commander of the Golden Collar
boss.king_goldenfang.intro: "Kneel, cat. Every kingdom bows to gold."
boss.king_goldenfang.hint: Golden Volley: deal heavy damage during the glow to stagger it, or absorb it with Nine-Lives Ward. His last phase combines charges and barrages.
ability.arc_storm.name: Arc Storm
ability.arc_storm.desc: Strike up to {targets} enemies in the chosen area for {mult}x Arc Bolt damage and interrupt them. Bosses resist the stun.
ability.ward.name: Nine-Lives Ward
ability.ward.desc: A barrier worth {pct} of maximum health for {duration}s. Barriers absorb damage before health.
ability.aim: Tap the battlefield to strike, tap Arc Storm again for the highlighted spot, or X to cancel.
priority.nearest.desc: Attack the enemy closest to the citadel.
priority.strongest.desc: Attack the enemy with the most health (great for bosses).
priority.rangedThreat.desc: Attack archers, priests and ranged bosses first.
perk.arc_forked_bolt.name: Forked Bolt
perk.arc_forked_bolt.desc: Arc Bolt chains to +{m:0} more enemy per stack. Each hop deals less damage; a chain never hits the same enemy twice.
perk.arc_static_mark.name: Static Mark
perk.arc_static_mark.desc: Arc Bolt marks enemies for {p:duration}s. Marked enemies take +{p%:bonus} Arc damage per stack.
perk.arc_thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
perk.arc_thunderclap.desc: The last hop of every chain bursts, dealing {p%:burstPct} of that hop's damage per stack to other enemies within {p:radius}m.
perk.arc_conductive_chill.name: Conductive Chill
perk.arc_conductive_chill.desc: Chains reach slowed enemies from {p:rangeMult}x farther and deal +{p%:damageBonus} damage to them.
perk.arc_overcharged_crown.name: Overcharged Crown
perk.arc_overcharged_crown.desc: Trade-off: maximum health {mx%:0}, all Arc damage {mx%:1}.
perk.ember_lingering_embers.name: Lingering Embers
perk.ember_cinder_spread.name: Cinder Spread
perk.ember_cinder_spread.desc: When a burning enemy dies, up to {p:targets} enemies within {p:radius}m catch fire at {p%:potency} strength.
perk.ember_molten_shell.name: Molten Shell
perk.ember_molten_shell.desc: Explosion radius +{m%:0} and splash damage +{m%:1} (of the direct hit) per stack.
perk.ember_furnace_heart.name: Furnace Heart
perk.ember_furnace_heart.desc: Every {p:heat} shell hits on burning enemies, Ember Maw fires {p%:haste} faster for {p:duration}s.
perk.ember_wildfire_pact.name: Wildfire Pact
perk.ember_wildfire_pact.desc: Trade-off: Ember Maw range {mx%:0}, all fire damage (shells and burning) {mx%:1}.
perk.frost_deep_chill.name: Deep Chill
perk.frost_deep_chill.desc: Frost Whisker slows +{m%:0} more per stack. Total slow is still capped at 60% (15% on bosses).
perk.frost_brittle_armour.name: Brittle Armour
perk.frost_brittle_armour.desc: Chilled enemies take +{p%:bonus} physical damage (Bone Ballista, bleeding excluded).
perk.frost_shatter.name: Shatter
perk.frost_shatter.desc: Frozen enemies that die shatter for {p:damage} frost damage within {p:radius}m and chill whatever they hit.
perk.frost_winter_ring.name: Winter Ring
perk.frost_winter_ring.desc: Every {p:interval}s a frost ring pulses {p:radius}m around the citadel for {p:damage} damage and a chill. More stacks: faster and wider.
perk.frost_frozen_oath.name: Frozen Oath
perk.frost_frozen_oath.desc: Trade-off: Frost Whisker damage {mx%:0}, freeze duration {mx%:1}, and freezes need {ma:2} fewer chill.
perk.bone_barbed_bolts.name: Barbed Bolts
perk.bone_barbed_bolts.desc: Ballista hits cause {p:dps} bleed damage/s per stack for {p:duration}s (up to {p:maxStacks} bleeds per enemy).
perk.bone_double_nock.name: Double Nock
perk.bone_double_nock.desc: Every {p:every}rd ballista shot fires an extra bolt at a second target.
perk.bone_armour_break.name: Armour Break
perk.bone_armour_break.desc: Ballista hits remove {p:armor} armour for {p:duration}s (does not stack, refreshes).
perk.bone_executioner.name: Executioner
perk.bone_executioner.desc: Ballista deals +{p%:bonus} damage per stack to enemies below {p%:threshold} health.
perk.bone_heavy_quarrels.name: Heavy Quarrels
perk.bone_heavy_quarrels.desc: Trade-off: ballista attack rate {mr%:0}, damage {mx%:1}, pierces +{m:2} more enemies.
perk.ward_reinforced_barrier.name: Reinforced Barrier
perk.ward_reinforced_barrier.desc: All barriers are +{m%:0} stronger per stack.
perk.ward_mending_purr.name: Mending Purr
perk.ward_mending_purr.desc: Ward Lantern repairs +{m:0} health/s per stack and regeneration is +{m%:1} per stack.
perk.ward_last_thread.name: Last Thread
perk.ward_last_thread.desc: Once per run, just before health would fall below {p%:threshold}, gain a barrier worth {p%:barrier} of maximum health for {p:duration}s.
perk.ward_reflective_fur.name: Reflective Fur
perk.ward_reflective_fur.desc: When a barrier absorbs a hit, {p%:pct} of the absorbed damage returns to the attacker (max {p:cap} per hit).
perk.ward_guardian_pact.name: Guardian Pact
perk.ward_guardian_pact.desc: Trade-off: all damage {mx%:0}, barriers {mx%:1}, Ward Lantern activates {mr%:2} faster.
perk.gravity_wider_orbit.name: Wider Orbit
perk.gravity_wider_orbit.desc: Gravity Paw pull radius +{m%:0} per stack.
perk.gravity_crushing_centre.name: Crushing Centre
perk.gravity_crushing_centre.desc: When a pull ends, enemies within {p:radius}m of the centre take {p:damage} damage per stack.
perk.gravity_event_horizon.name: Event Horizon
perk.gravity_event_horizon.desc: Enemies released from a pull are slowed {p%:slow} for {p:duration}s.
perk.gravity_falling_star.name: Falling Star
perk.gravity_falling_star.desc: Enemies pulled in the last {p:window}s take +{p%:bonus} damage from everything per stack.
perk.gravity_unstable_singularity.name: Unstable Singularity
perk.gravity_unstable_singularity.desc: Trade-off: Gravity Paw cooldown {mc%:0}, pulls last {mx%:1} longer and reach {mx%:2} wider.
perk.stacking_note: Percent bonuses of the same kind add together; trade-offs multiply.

upgrade.damage.desc: +8% damage for Arc Light Cat and all stations per level.
upgrade.attack_speed.name: Attack Speed

upgrade.collection.name: Collection

node.pm_arc_power.name: Stormcaller
node.pm_arc_power.desc: Arc Bolt and Arc Storm damage +6% per level.
node.pm_arc_storm.name: Quick Thunder
node.pm_arc_chain.name: Forked Crown
node.pm_arc_chain.desc: Arc Bolt starts every run with 1 chain target.
node.pm_arc_crit.name: Crackling Claws
node.pm_walls.name: Nine Walls
node.pm_mend.name: Mortar Purr
node.pm_mend.desc: +0.4 health regeneration per second per level.
node.pm_ward.name: Deeper Ward
node.pm_ward.desc: Nine-Lives Ward barrier +2% of maximum health per level.
node.pm_ward_haste.name: Ready Ward
node.pm_station_power.name: Oiled Gears
node.pm_station_speed.name: Busy Paws
node.pm_station_speed.desc: All station attack/activation rate +4% per level.
node.pm_synergy.name: Kindred Stations
node.pm_synergy.desc: Percentage synergy bonuses and barrier haste are 25% stronger.
node.pm_moon_gold.name: Moonlit Coffers
node.pm_moon_gold.desc: Moon Gold from missions +8% per level.
node.pm_start_sparks.name: Pocket Sparks
node.pm_start_sparks.desc: Start every run with +30 Spark Coins per level.
node.pm_xp.name: Quick Study
node.pm_offline.name: Night Shift
node.pm_offline.desc: Offline Moon Gold rate +15% per level.
mission.m01.name: The Crooked Gate
mission.m01.desc: Learn to defend the citadel. Arc Light Cat attacks on his own.
mission.m02.name: Moonlit Hedgerows
mission.m02.desc: Archers and bats join the raid. A third station slot opens early.
mission.m03.name: Graveyard Toll
mission.m03.desc: Bell Priests heal their troops. Silence them first.
mission.m04.name: Broken Wall Run
mission.m04.desc: Shield Guards advance while Powder Rats light their kegs.
mission.m05.name: The Lantern Path
mission.m05.desc: Iron Golems lumber out of the fog.
mission.m06.name: Barkhelm's Siege
mission.m06.desc: Sir Barkhelm, the Iron Hound, leads the assault.
mission.m07.name: Moonfall Steps
mission.m07.desc: The ruins hum with storm light. Enemies move faster here.
mission.m08.name: Statue Garden
mission.m08.desc: A choir of Bell Priests guards the statues.
mission.m09.name: The Bell Tower Fall
mission.m09.desc: Mother Carrion descends with her bell.
mission.m10.name: Courtyard of Cinders
mission.m10.desc: The Iron Tide: armoured troops and golems.
mission.m11.name: Violet Vigil
mission.m11.desc: The night sky fills with wings and arrows.
mission.m12.name: Throne of Goldenfang
mission.m12.desc: King Goldenfang comes for the Stormheart himself.

modifier.powder_night.desc: Powder Rats appear far more often.
modifier.moon_haste.name: Moon Haste
modifier.sanctified.name: Sanctified
modifier.sanctified.desc: Bell Priests appear far more often.
modifier.iron_tide.name: Iron Tide
modifier.iron_tide.desc: Enemies gain +15 armour; more guards and golems.

modifier.gilded_wrath.name: Gilded Wrath
modifier.endless_frenzy.name: Frenzy
modifier.endless_frenzy.desc: Enemies move 12% faster and hit 10% harder.
modifier.endless_bulwark.name: Bulwark
modifier.endless_bulwark.desc: Enemies have 15% more health and +10 armour.

announce.finale: Finale! The Order sends its champions.
announce.stragglers: The stragglers panic and rush the citadel!
announce.barrage: Barrage marked! Kill archers in the red zone.
announce.volley: GOLDEN VOLLEY! Stagger it or ward it!
tip.rat_raider: Rat Raiders came in numbers. Arc Coil chains and Ember Maw splash clear packs.
tip.hound_runner: Hound Runners flanked you. Nearest targeting and Frost Whisker slows catch them.
tip.shield_guard: Shield Guards shrugged off your hits. Bone Ballista pierces their armour.
tip.crow_archer: Crow Archers shot from range. Switch to Ranged Threat targeting.
tip.bat: Bat Swarms overwhelmed you. Chains, splash and Frost pulses hit many at once.
tip.bell_priest: Bell Priests kept healing. Ranged Threat targeting silences them first.
tip.powder_rat: Powder Rats exploded. Stun (Arc Storm), freeze or pull them while their fuse burns.
tip.iron_golem: Iron Golems battered the walls. Bone Ballista and damage upgrades crack them.
tip.sir_barkhelm: Sir Barkhelm wore you down. Try Strongest targeting and clear his guards.
tip.barkhelm_charge: The charge hit hard. When the boss steps back and glows, cast Nine-Lives Ward.
tip.mother_carrion: Mother Carrion's flock overwhelmed you. Bring anti-swarm stations.
tip.carrion_barrage: The barrage landed. Kill archers in the red sector and ward the rest.
tip.king_goldenfang: King Goldenfang outlasted you. Permanent upgrades and Strongest targeting help.
tip.goldenfang_volley: The Golden Volley hit. Burst the king while he glows, or ward it.
tip.default: Buy damage and health upgrades earlier, and use both abilities often.
story.1: Exiled for his lightning, Arc Light Cat found a relic in the ruins: the Stormheart.
story.2: Around it he raised the Nine-Lives Citadel, a refuge for every cursed cat.
story.3: The Golden Collar Order called his clan the "Evil Cats" - and marched.
chapter.gravewood.end: Gravewood is quiet. Sir Barkhelm's collar hangs on the citadel gate as a warning.
chapter.moonfall.end: The Golden Collar is broken. The Evil Cats are free - and delightfully smug.
bark.1: Nine lives. Your army gets one chance.
bark.3: Is that the best the Order can do?
bark.defeat: Merely a nap. I have lives to spare.
tutorial.welcome: Arc Light Cat attacks automatically. Just watch - and decide.
tutorial.sparks: Enemies drop Spark Coins. Spend them on upgrades in the bottom dock.
tutorial.slot: A new station slot opened! Ember Maw now fires explosive shells.
tutorial.perk: Level up! Choose a perk - each one changes how your citadel fights.
tutorial.storm: Arc Storm is ready. Tap it, then tap a group of enemies.
tutorial.ward: Nine-Lives Ward makes a barrier that absorbs damage. Use it when hits get heavy.
tutorial.priority: Tap the target button to switch between Nearest, Strongest and Ranged Threat.
tutorial.speed: Tap 2x to speed up the battle. The outcome is the same at either speed.

ui.credits.title: Credits & Support
ui.credits.body:
Evil Cats - an original game.
Art, music and sound: generated by the project's own reproducible tools.
Font: Pixelify Sans by Stefie Justprince (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
Built with Unity.
